title: Provider-neutral agent runner + dsh adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral agent-runner seam (`AgentRunner`/`CommandRunner` traits, task/result/capability types, prompt and QUESTION-line helpers) plus in-memory fakes, and the first concrete adapter, `DshAgentRunner`, which drives `dsh --profile headless --json -` through a `CommandRunner`, parses its newline-delimited JSON events, guards the repository with git status/head/branch checks, and reports capabilities by probing `--version`, headless `--help` and `--dump-config`. A new `job-blocked` journal payload carries a clarification question, and `RUN_ENV_VARS` is widened to `pub(crate)` so git commands get a minimal, credential-free environment.

nodes.label: Develop job
nodes.summary: The factory job that hands a task to an agent and consumes the plain-data result. It is the caller the new seam exists for; it is not changed here.

nodes.label: AgentRunner trait
nodes.subtitle: run(&dyn CommandRunner, &AgentTask)
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral seam: one method to run a task and one to probe capabilities. Nothing in the module names an agent, a command or a model vendor.

nodes.label: CommandRunner trait
nodes.subtitle: run(&CommandSpec) -> CommandOutput
nodes.summary: The single seam through which any process is started. Adapters never spawn a process themselves; they build a CommandSpec and hand it to a runner.

nodes.label: RealCommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: env_clear, process group, timeout
nodes.summary: The production CommandRunner: clears the environment, sets exactly the command's own, starts the child as its own process-group leader on Unix, drains both pipes on threads, and kills the whole tree at the deadline (default one hour).

nodes.label: build_prompt / question_line
nodes.subtitle: RULES + QUESTION: marker
nodes.summary: Pure helpers: build_prompt appends the four fixed rules to the task text; question_line reads a trailing `QUESTION:` line from the final message, case-sensitively, ignoring earlier lines and empty text.

nodes.label: AgentTask / AgentRunResult / Capability
nodes.subtitle: plain serializable data
nodes.summary: The data the seam carries: the task in, the run result (actor, session, final message, outcome, changed files, branch, base commit, usage, cost) and the capability report out. All Serialize for the journal.

nodes.label: FakeRunner / FakeAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: scripted replay, records calls
nodes.summary: In-memory doubles that replay scripted answers and record every command and task, so a full run can be exercised without starting a process.

nodes.label: DshAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: impl AgentRunner for dsh
nodes.summary: The first concrete adapter. It rejects an empty task or a dirty tree, snapshots head and branch, runs dsh headless with the prompt on stdin, parses the JSON events, then re-checks status/head/branch and builds the AgentRunResult.

nodes.label: DshConfig
nodes.subtitle: program, env, pinned version
nodes.summary: How to reach the dsh binary: its program, its complete child environment, and the pinned version (0.2.0-rc.2) that `--version` must report.

nodes.label: parse_events
nodes.subtitle: newline-delimited JSON
nodes.summary: Reduces dsh's JSONL events to session id, final message, summed usage and the first non-completed turn reason. A non-JSON line is an error naming its line number.

nodes.label: status / head / branch commands
nodes.subtitle: git_env allow-list
nodes.summary: Builds the git commands the adapter runs, each carrying only the minimal git environment (RUN_ENV_VARS, HOME, GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_*), so the agent's credential never reaches git.

nodes.label: capability probes
nodes.subtitle: --version, --help, --dump-config
nodes.summary: Probes what dsh can do: version pin, headless help (needs --json and stdin), and the profile dump for a message-check plugin. A probe that cannot run is Unknown, never Unsupported or Supported.

nodes.label: Payload::JobBlocked
nodes.subtitle: cause + question
nodes.summary: A new journal payload for a job that ended blocked, carrying the cause and, for a clarification, the question the agent asked. Replay passes it through unchanged.

nodes.label: RUN_ENV_VARS
nodes.subtitle: now pub(crate)
nodes.summary: The platform run variables reviewers already get, widened from private to crate-visible so the dsh adapter can reuse the same allow-list for git.

nodes.label: dsh binary
nodes.subtitle: --profile headless --json -
nodes.summary: The external coding agent. It reads the prompt on stdin and writes newline-delimited JSON events to stdout; it reports no model name and no cost figure.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: status / rev-parse
nodes.summary: The repository tool the adapter uses to guard the tree and read head and branch, run with the minimal environment.

nodes.label: harness fixtures
nodes.subtitle: recorded dsh runs
nodes.summary: Recorded dsh output (created file, question variants, missing credential, version, help, dump-config) that the parser and adapter tests replay.

edges.label: run(task)
edges.summary: The develop job drives an agent through the neutral trait, not a concrete adapter.

edges.label: &dyn CommandRunner
edges.summary: Every adapter receives a CommandRunner and starts no process of its own.

edges.label: impl AgentRunner
edges.summary: The dsh adapter is the first concrete implementation of the neutral seam.

edges.label: headless JSON run
edges.summary: The adapter builds the dsh command and hands it to the runner, which starts the process.

views.title: Agent-runner seam and dsh adapter
views.summary: The neutral seam, its fakes, the dsh adapter and the processes it drives.
